_status: TIMES AND PRICES PULLED, 2026-08-03. This file previously carried per-location happy hour windows and drink and food prices lifted from the happy-hour design concept. None of it appears in CLIENT_FACTS.md, which has no happy hour data at all. It was published for roughly one build and then removed on Steve's call.
_whyPulled: A happy hour window is the same class of promise as an opening hour, and CLIENT_FACTS.md forbids publishing opening hours the door does not honor. The failure mode is identical and it is not abstract: someone reads 11:30am to 6:00pm, drives to Convoy at 5, and the window shut at 4. Prices are worse, because CLAUDE.md says menu prices are never published without explicit client approval and nobody at Tajima has seen these.
_howToRestore: Get the real windows and prices from Amanda, per location, in writing. Add `windows`, `drinks`, and `food` arrays back to each entry below and the template will render them again: the markup for all three is still in src/happy-hour.njk behind an `if`. Do NOT restore the concept values.
_whatIsConfirmed: Only three things on this page trace to CLIENT_FACTS.md. (1) Happy hour exists and is worth a page: it earns 1,361 clicks and 49% CTR on `tajima happy hour`. (2) Plaza Bonita is quick-serve with no alcohol, so it has no happy hour at all. (3) East Village runs Padres game-night beer specials and extended hours on home game nights. That last one is confirmed for EAST VILLAGE ONLY and must not be widened to the other rooms.

_plazaReconciliation:
RAISED TO HIGH PRIORITY 2026-09-09. THREE independent sources now point the same way and this file's original phrasing pointed the other way.

1. src/_data/toastMenus/plaza-bonita.json carries a priced Happy Hours section, pulled from that room's own live Toast catalog on 2026-08-04.
2. The room's own Google Business Profile description, in Connor's export of 2026-09-09, tells visitors to come for happy hour and advertises discounted drinks and appetizers. That is the client's own published marketing on their own profile.
3. Against those, CLIENT_FACTS.md says quick-serve, food court format, limited menu, no alcohol.

THESE MAY ALL BE TRUE AT ONCE. A food happy hour with discounted appetizers and non-alcoholic drinks is entirely compatible with a room that serves no alcohol, and the GBP copy's 'discounted drinks' does not say alcoholic drinks. So this is probably not a contradiction about alcohol at all; it is that this file once said 'no happy hour at all', which no source supports and two now contradict outright.

THE SITE IS ALREADY SAFE AND NEEDS NO EDIT TO STAY SAFE. /happy-hour/ publishes only the CLIENT_FACTS.md fact, no alcohol, and 'no happy hour at all' was removed on 2026-09-09. Nothing on the site claims the room has no happy hour and nothing claims it has one.

WHAT TO ASK AMANDA: does Plaza Bonita run a happy hour, and if so what is on it and when? If the answer is yes, this room moves out of the no-alcohol branch on /happy-hour/ and into the normal one, and the GBP description becomes a source we can cite rather than a contradiction we are working around. NOTE THAT THE GBP DESCRIPTION ITSELF IS STILL NOT PUBLISHABLE COPY: it is written against the retired positioning and uses banned language. It is evidence that a happy hour exists, not text we can lift.
